extract_iteration_info: extract iteration information from a Trace object and return a DataFrame with rank and iteration columns
compute_normalized_start_time_of_signifi: compute the normalized start time of significant NCCL communication kernels for straggler detection from trace data
get_top_k_stragglers_with_metric: get the top k potential straggler ranks based on a performance metric DataFrame and threshold values
find_stragglers_with_late_start_comm_ker: identify potential straggler ranks from trace DataFrames by analyzing late-starting communication kernels across iterations
review_straggler_detection: review the straggler detection module to understand how late-start communication kernels are used to identify straggler ranks
